## Articles

- [Distribution Without One Central Algorithm](https://decentralized.turtleand.com/topics/distribution-without-one-central-algorithm/): How Mastodon distributes content through federation instead of one global ranking system.
- [Bitcoin Is Heavy Because It Bundles Trust](https://decentralized.turtleand.com/topics/bitcoin-blockchain-trust-unbundling/): Why blockchains bundle trust problems and how newer systems unbundle them.
- [Swapping Legacy sUSD on Optimism](https://decentralized.turtleand.com/topics/swapping-legacy-susd-optimism/): A practical account of a legacy token migration and its wallet trade-offs.
